about: Karate Kyle is a vintage-looking portrait of a teenage boy in a red karate uniform and orange belt, glasses on, fists raised in a fighting stance. Behind him floats a giant, semi-transparent close-up of his own serious face, a classic double-exposure studio effect that makes the whole picture look like a 1980s action movie poster. Captions turn him into an over-the-top vigilante whose revenge for minor school slights is wildly out of proportion. The humor comes from that dead-serious photo paired with absurdly extreme payback.
origin: The photo was posted to Facebook in 2011 and quickly became an advice animal, part of the same family as other revenge characters like Vengeance Dad.
usage:
The top box is the small offense done to Kyle, and the bottom box is his ridiculous, cartoon-level response. The classic structure is a short "they did X" / "I did Y" pair, with the second line escalating as far as possible.

Keep the revenge absurd rather than realistic: roundhouse kicks through walls, black belts earned overnight, entire cafeterias defeated. It also works for gamers and coworkers, where an annoying teammate or a stolen stapler provokes an epic, wildly excessive answer.
ideas: they cut in the lunch line
i chopped their desk in half
i earned a black belt by friday
